教室にやってくると、パイロットスーツ姿の白奈がいた。: When I came to the classroom, I found Shirona in her pilot suit.
白奈、お疲れ。さっきの天穹のシミュレーター訓練\nデータを見せてもらったが、なか:
Good work, Shirona. I saw the data from your earlier Tenkyu simulator session.
You were moving pretty well.
うん、ありがとう。でも、この補助スーツ……\n体のラインがはっきり出ちゃうから、:
Mm, thanks. But this support suit...
It really shows off my figure. It's still embarrassing.
（はは……める達も言ってたな）: (Haha... Meru and the others said the same thing.)
……で、何でそんな格好で教室に？: ...So why are you in the classroom dressed like that?
なるほど……\nその様子だとまだ探し中ってところか。:
I see...
Looks like you're still searching, then.
最後に鍵を持っていたのはいつだ？: When did you last have the key?
校舎の落とし物ボックスにもなかったから、\n本当にどこにあるのかわからない……:
It wasn't in the school building's lost-and-found box either,
so I really don't know where it is...
まだ校内に残ってる人に、鍵を拾ってないか聞いて回ろう。: Let's ask everyone who's still at school if they've found a key.
えっ、この格好で聞き回るの……？: Huh? Go around asking people... dressed like this?
せっかくここまで誰とも会わないようにしてきたのに……\nさすがに少し恥ずかしい…:
I went out of my way to get here without running into anyone...
That's a little embarrassing...
だったら……そうだ。今日俺上着持ってきてるから、それを羽織るか？\n少なくとも上:
Then... Oh, I brought my jacket today. Want to put it on?
It should at least cover your upper half.
うん……それならオーケー。\nいろんな意味で、名案。:
Mm... That works.
A good idea. In more ways than one.
その後、俺達は鍵を求めて聞き込み調査をするのだった。\n途中、なぜか白奈の顔は終:
After that, we went around asking about the key.
For some reason, Shirona seemed to be blushing the whole time. Or was I imagining it?
ちなみに鍵は見つからなかった……が、そもそもロッカーを\n施錠し忘れていたようで:
We never found the key... But it turned out she'd forgotten
to lock her locker in the first place, so things worked out anyway.
うろうろ探し回る前に、\nまずなくしたタイミングを思い出してみないか？:
Before we go wandering around looking,
why don't you try remembering when you lost it?
最後に持っていたのは……シミュレーター室で……: The last time I had it... was in the simulator room...
みんなの分の飲み物を買いに行こうとして……ポケットもないし、\n帰りはペットボト:
I was going to buy drinks for everyone... But I had no pockets,
and I'd be carrying ５ bottles back, so I left it with Meru...
そうしてその後まだ更衣室に残っていためるから、\nなんとか鍵を取り戻したのだった:
After that, we managed to get the key back from Meru,
who was still in the changing room.
彼女自身も預かったことを忘れていたらしく、\nたくさん謝られた。:
She'd apparently forgotten she was holding it too,
and apologized over and over.
